## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO — `git commit -s`)
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && ./vendor/bin/phpunit`)
- [ ] Frontend lint + tests + build pass (`cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, config, or integrations changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer data committed
- [ ] Synthetic/demo data is clearly labeled
